mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM sys.role WHERE use_yn='Y' AND role_nm IN #{name}

INSERT INTO sys.user_info(lgn_id,pswd_hash,user_nm,pswd_chg_need_yn) VALUES(#{login},#{hash},#{login},'N') ON CONFLICT(lgn_id) DO UPDATE SET pswd_hash=EXCLUDED.pswd_hash,pswd_chg_need_yn='N',user_stts_cd='ACTIVE',lgn_fail_cnt=0,otp_fail_cnt=0,rsgn_dt=NULL RETURNING user_id
